title: Clarify pending publish launch action
summary: Clarified the backend-authored pending-publish launch gate action text shown in the Launch backend preflight table.
reason: The old action used drain/review shorthand that was hard to read in the Backend Action column.
behavior_before: Pending-publish bytes and age blockers said to drain or review parked outputs before launching new work.
behavior_after: Pending-publish bytes and age blockers now say to publish the parked outputs, or review the ones that are not ready, before starting more queue work.
rollback_plan: Revert the two next_action string changes in src/mediapipeline/core/diagnostics/autonomy_health.py and refresh that generated summary.
notes:
